page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 8 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The CPU includes a 40 MB L3 cache and supports AVX, AES, and FMA instruction sets, though it lacks AVX-512 capabilities. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core.

This instance integrates a dedicated NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM, making it suitable for entry-level GPU workloads. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage must be network-attached. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the CPU and memory subsystems operate on the lower end of modern cloud hardware. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 953.38 falls in the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score of 4755.08 is in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show weak results, with uncached read-only large block speeds at 37.18 GB/sec and write speeds at 25.34 GB/sec. Passmark CPU score sits in the average tier at 6698.53, but database operations and Redis SET performance remain in the bottom 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a budget-friendly entry point for GPU-accelerated tasks due to its older Pascal-generation hardware. It is best suited for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand high-performance CPU compute or massive memory bandwidth, such as legacy video transcoding, basic deep learning inference, and lightweight CUDA-based processing.
